question: 8 kg of maize costing ₹51 per kg, is mixed with 9 kg of maize costing ₹68 per kg. The average per kg price of mixed maize is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed average price be ₹51 per kg.

Net deviation of 9 kg maize = 9 × (68 − 51) = +153

Distribute this net deviation over the total mixture (8 kg + 9 kg = 17 kg).

Average increase = 153 ÷ 17 = +9

Actual average = 51 + 9 = ₹60 per kg.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quantity of first type (Q₁) = 8 kg, Cost (P₁) = ₹51 per kg

Quantity of second type (Q₂) = 9 kg, Cost (P₂) = ₹68 per kg

**Formula Used:**

Average price = (Q₁ × P₁ + Q₂ × P₂) ÷ (Q₁ + Q₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2468cb37b36fdb790bc13320a447f5b12a43137a626915f72de23426aa7011f4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total cost of 8 kg maize = 8 × 51 = ₹408

⇒ Total cost of 9 kg maize = 9 × 68 = ₹612

⇒ Total cost of the mixture = 408 + 612 = ₹1020

⇒ Total quantity of the mixture = 8 + 9 = 17 kg

⇒ Average price = 1020 ÷ 17 = ₹60 per kg

**∴ The correct answer is ₹60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rule of Alligation

It helps to find the exact ratio in which two ingredients at given prices must be mixed to produce a mixture of a desired average price. Ratio = (Dearer Price − Average Price) : (Average Price − Cheaper Price).

Weighted Average

When different quantities have varying numeric values, the combined average is given by: A = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ...) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ...).

Replacement Method

If V is the total volume of pure liquid, and x volume is repeatedly replaced with water n times, the final volume of pure liquid is: Final = Initial × (1 − x ÷ V)ⁿ.
